script.code:
SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(i.stock_control AS CHAR) AS stock_control,
       CAST(i.show_delivery AS CHAR) AS show_delivery,
       CAST(i.serial_number_management AS CHAR) AS serial_number_management,
       CAST(i.item_batch_management AS CHAR) AS item_batch_management,
       CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR) AS based_uom,
       i.material_costing_method,
       CAST(i.net_weight AS CHAR) AS net_weight
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.organizationId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN ({{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.materialIdsSql}})

SELECT CAST(c.Item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(c.alt_uom_id AS CHAR) AS alt_uom_id,
       CAST(c.base_qty AS CHAR) AS base_qty
  FROM item_mji552rc_sub c
 WHERE c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.tenantId}}'
   AND c.is_deleted = 0
   AND c.Item_id IN ({{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.materialIdsSql}})

SELECT CAST(p.Item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(p.uom_id AS CHAR) AS uom_id,
       CAST(p.quantity AS CHAR) AS quantity,
       CAST(p.packing_uom_id AS CHAR) AS packing_uom_id,
       CAST(p.packing_qty AS CHAR) AS packing_qty
  FROM item_vabbbwt2_sub p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.is_deleted = 0
   AND p.Item_id IN ({{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.materialIdsSql}})

script.code:
SELECT 'REG' AS kind,
       CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,
       '' AS batch_id,
       '' AS serial_number,
       CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS unrestricted_qty,
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(b.block_qty AS CHAR) AS block_qty,
       CAST(b.qualityinsp_qty AS CHAR) AS qualityinsp_qty,
       CAST(b.intransit_qty AS CHAR) AS intransit_qty,
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS balance_quantity,
       CAST(b.material_uom AS CHAR) AS material_uom,
       CAST(bl.bin_location_combine AS CHAR) AS bin_location_combine
  FROM item_balance b
  LEFT JOIN bin_location bl
    ON bl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.tenantId}}'
   AND bl.id = b.location_id
   AND bl.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.plantId}}
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.materialIdsSql}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BATCH' AS kind,
       CAST(bb.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(bb.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,

script.code:
SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       r.parent_line_id,
       CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR) AS open_qty,
       CAST(r.item_uom AS CHAR) AS item_uom,
       CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.tenantId}}'
   AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.organizationId}}'
   AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.plantId}}
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
   AND r.status = 'Pending'
   AND r.parent_line_id IN ({{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.soLineIdsQuoted}})

   AND h.is_deleted = 0
   AND h.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_fCaK9LEC.data.materialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY h.material_id
